description: This file implements an admission plugin for Kubernetes that enforces restrictions on Pod AntiAffinity topology keys, specifically allowing only 'kubernetes.io/hostname'. It includes registration, validation logic, and plugin structure.

classes.description: Represents the admission plugin that validates Pod AntiAffinity topology keys.
